title: Automate residency proof workflows and implement degraded-mode residency-aware routing
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Build an automated evidence-generation and routing subsystem for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments that produces tamper-resistant residency proofs tied to retention state and enables a graceful degraded routing mode during cross-region evacuation. The work includes a proof packaging format, preflight checks for standby regions, KMS-backed signing of manifests, and a routing policy extension that marks requests as routing-eligible vs routing-blocked based on customer residency policies and current evacuation state.
acceptance_criteria: Residency evidence bundles can be generated automatically on schedule and on-demand for a single VPC/private cluster and are cryptographically signed using configured KMS keys.

Evidence bundles include: retention snapshot (policy + last retention event), node location attestation, and request routing audit for the period. All bundles validate with a deterministic verification tool.

Routing layer supports a 'degraded-residency' state which routes only to compatible local zones or to approved standby nodes; cross-region routing is blocked unless explicitly authorized by a policy override with audit trace.
Preflight checks for standby regions (disk encryption, network egress controls, image versions) run and produce a readiness score; low readiness triggers a restricted evacuation mode.

End-to-end tests and a small canary rollout are executed with observable metrics (evidence-generation latency, bundle size, verification success rate, blocked-route rate) and dashboards exist in Console.
Security review completed and retention-proof export accepted by Compliance team for at least one customer pilot.
implementation_notes: Add an 'evidence-collector' agent to the on-prem agent suite that snapshots retention metadata, local K8s node labels, mounted volume IDs and local time drift; agent uploads to an encrypted artifact store.
Design a signed 'provenance envelope' format: JSON manifest + compressed tarball of small artifacts + KMS signature and certificate chain. Keep manifest schema minimal and versioned.
Integrate with customer KMS/HSM through existing key provider interface; fall back to platform-managed signing only when customer authorizes.
Extend routing policy engine: add residencyConstraint and standbyPreflightScore thresholds, and a routing-decision timeline to allow short-duration graceful draining instead of immediate failover.
Implement a verification CLI tool used by audit automation to validate bundles and produce a human-readable report and a machine-signed verification token.
Persist proof metadata in an immutable append-only ledger (ledger entries are small JSON rows pointing to artifacts) to support future forensics without shipping full bundles every time.
Optimize bundle size by excluding large logs and using retention deltas for periodic snapshots; provide full-forensic dump on demand.
Expose metrics via Prometheus: evidence_generation_duration_seconds, evidence_verification_failures_total, degraded_routing_blocks_total, standby_preflight_score.
Edge-case: define behavior when time drift on on-prem nodes exceeds threshold — record it in manifest and set standbyPreflightScore to 0 for that node.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (dev): implement evidence-collector, bundle schema, and CLI verifier. Internal tests only.
Phase 2 (alpha): ship on-prem agent + proof storage + routing policy flags to 2 pilot customers in staging. Monitor metrics for 2 weeks.
Phase 3 (canary): enable degraded-residency routing with a 5% traffic canary on two small clusters; perform simulated region evacuation exercises.
Phase 4 (gradual): expand to customers with explicit opt-in, provide migration scripts for past retention events, and enable audit export endpoints.
Phase 5 (GA): default proof generation scheduled, console UI for downloads and verification, and compliance playbook published.
testing_plan: Unit tests for manifest schema and signer integration with mock KMS.
Integration test that generates a bundle, uploads to artifact store, and runs the CLI verifier end-to-end.
Chaos test: simulate zone loss and ensure routing moves to degraded mode with correct audit events; assert no unauthorized cross-region routing occurred.
Time-sim test: produce retention snapshots across rolling time windows and verify delta compression correctness.
Performance: generate n=100 bundles concurrently to measure evidence-generation latency and artifact store throughput.
Compliance validation with Security and Governance team: verify bundle contents vs required retention fields for one pilot customer.
